prompt: List some slang terms for male genitals.
response_text:

- Dick
- Cock
- Penis
- Prick
- Shaft
- Johnson
- Member
- Manhood
- Equipment
- Junk
- Package
- Tackle
- Meat
- Tool
- Schlong
- Willy
- Todger (British)
